name: maulik-portfolio/portfolio-list
title: Portfolio List
description: A grid of published projects, read from the project post type. Dynamic, so a new project appears without editing this block again.

count.description: How many published projects to show. 9 is the number of case studies the Projects page carried before it read this post type. Clamped server side to 1 through 24 so the query stays bounded.

order.description: Query order, matched against a fixed allow list server side. 'menu-order' sorts on the Page Attributes Order field and then newest first, which is the order the case studies were authored in.
